CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERTELEPHONENUMBER_SEC
AS
BEGIN
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
(
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
)
,
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber
AS(
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Cellphone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.CELLPHONE AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'Y' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.CELLPHONE NOT IN ('',' ') 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.CELLPHONE IS NOT NULL

UNION
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Cellphone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.CELLPHONE2 AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'Y' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.CELLPHONE2 NOT IN ('',' ') 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.CELLPHONE IS NOT NULL

UNION
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Home Phone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.HOME_PHONE AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'N' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.HOME_PHONE NOT IN ('',' ') 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.HOME_PHONE IS NOT NULL

UNION
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Office Phone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.OFC_PHONE AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'N' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.OFC_PHONE NOT IN ('',' ') 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.OFC_PHONE IS NOT NULL

UNION
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,'Permanent Address Phone Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BSC.PERM_PHONE AS TelephoneNumber
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,'N' AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSC.PERM_PHONE NOT IN ('',' ') 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.PERM_PHONE IS NOT NULL

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,TelephoneNumberTypeId
,TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,TelephoneNumberTypeId
,TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE SOURCECODE = 'SEC'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;

-------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL AND TGT.SOURCECODE = 'SEC'	;

-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[TelephoneNumberTypeId]
,[TelephoneNumber]
,[PeriodStartTimestamp]
,[PeriodEndTimestamp]
,[PreferenceId]
,[TelephoneNumberNote]
,[LocationId]
,[TextCapableIndicator]
,[ExtensionNumber]
,[DoNotDisturbIndicator]
,[DateOfRequest]
,[AreaCode]
,[CountryCode]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,TelephoneNumberTypeId AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
,TelephoneNumber AS TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS TelephoneNumberNote
,NULL AS LocationId
,TextCapableIndicator AS TextCapableIndicator
,NULL AS ExtensionNumber
,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
,NULL AS DateOfRequest
,NULL AS AreaCode
,NULL AS CountryCode
,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'



---------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[TelephoneNumberTypeId]
,[TelephoneNumber]
,[PeriodStartTimestamp]
,[PeriodEndTimestamp]
,[PreferenceId]
,[TelephoneNumberNote]
,[LocationId]
,[TextCapableIndicator]
,[ExtensionNumber]
,[DoNotDisturbIndicator]
,[DateOfRequest]
,[AreaCode]
,[CountryCode]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
 CustomerId AS CustomerId
,TelephoneNumberTypeId AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
,TelephoneNumber AS TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS TelephoneNumberNote
,NULL AS LocationId
,TextCapableIndicator AS TextCapableIndicator
,NULL AS ExtensionNumber
,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
,NULL AS DateOfRequest
,NULL AS AreaCode
,NULL AS CountryCode
,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;


END
